data: What is the value of MI(C;W,V|G) in Czech?

The question asks for the value of MI(C;W,V|G) in Czech. From the provided information, this corresponds to the value of mutual information between the declension class (C), word form (W), and meaning (V), given gender (G). In the legend on the right side of the figure, the value for this quantity in Czech is explicitly stated as 0.98. Therefore, the value of MI(C;W,V|G) in Czech is 0.98.
